messages:
alert-bot: :rotating_light: Alert: GPU pool 'infer-prod-eu-3' at 98% alloc, autoscaler hit max_replicas=48, queue depth 1200. Detected sharp increase in average context length and kv-cache miss rate after deploy at 21:12 UTC.
irene: seeing same in dashboards, tail latency spiking to 4.2s token, request queueing increasing. reassigning to oncall.
on-call: @oncall-ml please take.
oncall-ml: taking. pinging infra and ml.
mike: I pushed model v2.14 to prod at 21:12 — it had a context-padding fix but also changed kv layout. Rolling forward because of perf wins in bench, but didn't expect wider context growth.
sasha: load graphs show avg ctx len jumped from 512 to ~2300 for a subset of routes. kv-cache warmup rate looks poor, high miss ratio -> more memory and GPU IO.
raj: autoscaler logs: "scale_up_skipped: quota_exhausted" and "reached_max_replicas" starting 21:16. we configured burstable limits but commit was lower than surge needs.
irene: customers complaining of intermittent 503/502 from API, some request timeouts. error rate to SLO up 3.8%. need mitigation plan now.
anna: support triage says 4 enterprise tenants reporting timeouts, some on dedicated pools but routing fell back to shared causing contention.
mike: immediate rollback to v2.13? that's safest. Is canary still running or fully rolled?
sasha: rollout was 100% at 21:20, canary passed quick smoke so full rollout. we can trigger rollback via deploy bot but expect some cold-start kv warmups after rollback too.
irene: mitigation steps: 1) open oncall bridge; 2) throttle heavy-context routes; 3) if quick, rollback to v2.13; 4) request temporary capacity increase from infra; 5) customer comms draft. Who owns each?
irene: opening bridge now: https://call.example/bridge/4945000001
oncall-ml: I'll put up a quick routing rule to send known long-context routes to a low-memory variant (model-v2.14-small) and enable per-customer rate limit. Doing that now.
deploy-bot: command received: set-route-rule --route "*/longctx/*" --variant model-v2.14-small --priority 10
deploy-bot: OK: rule applied in 12s.
sasha: routing change reduced incoming long-context to big pool by ~65% in 2m, queue depth falling from 1200 -> 420. latency follow-down in dashboards.
raj: requested emergency capacity increase (+6 GPUs) from cloud provider, queued approval 21:33. ETA ~9-12 minutes.
mike: initiating rollback to v2.13 now to restore previous kv layout and context behavior. command: ```deploy rollback model:v2.13 --env=prod --force```
deploy-bot: rollback started at 21:36, rollout paused at 30% to monitor.
irene: monitoring: queue depth plateaued ~380 during rollback pause. Error rate dropping slowly. keep rollback in cautious mode.
anna: support notify: drafting message for affected customers: short blurb + ETA for mitigation. Will post to status page after infra OKs.
oncall-ml: note: when rolling back, we'll trigger heavy kv-cache churn since v2.13 warmup pattern differs. Expect a transient spike; mitigating via gradual traffic shift.
sasha: I pushed a temporary kv-cache TTL extension and disabled aggressive prefill on the big pool to reduce memory churn: ```kv_cache.set_ttl(1800)``` and ```prefill.enabled=false``` — applied 21:40.
raj: capacity increase approved at 21:45, provisioning started. cloud reports new nodes in 10m.
mike: rollback hit 90% by 21:48. finalizing.
deploy-bot: rollback complete at 21:49. All replicas now serving model v2.13.
irene: after rollback + routing rules + kv-tweaks, queue depth down to 70, latency back near baseline, error rate trending to normal. Good.
anna: support message posted to status page: "Partial degradation affecting text-gen latency and intermittent errors 21:12–21:49 UTC. Root cause: model rollout caused unexpected context growth and kv-cache miss amplification, leading to GPU saturation. Rollback and routing mitigations applied."
sasha: postmortem items: 1) add rollout preflight check for context distribution divergence; 2) require kv-layout compatibility flag; 3) autoscaler to emit early warning when queue/ctx metric combo spikes; 4) update playbook for routing to small-variant and TTL changes.
mike: I'll open PR for rollback runbook and add canary longer-duration checks.
raj: follow-up: increase max_replicas config window during rollouts to allow transient surge, or add burst auto-capacity policy.
oncall-ml: handing back to oncall rotation at 22:05. logging incident as Sev2 with timeline.
irene: assigning owner for incident postmortem: sasha (eng-runtime) and mike (ml) co-authors. anna will help with customer comms notes.
anna: will coordinate customer follow-up emails tomorrow, include impacted tenant list, duration, and mitigation details.
sasha: saving logs snapshot and KV metrics to the incident bucket: s3://redwood-incidents/4945000001/logs.tar.gz
irene: thanks team. closing bridge in 10. if anything else flares, reopen thread. :thumbsup:
